title: Multi-Region training with Amazon SageMaker HyperPod and Qumulo
summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod and Cloud Native Qumulo let you place training compute in one AWS Region while keeping your dataset in another. This post shares the architecture and validation results from a cross-Region training run, where a remote cluster matched a co-located cluster
